name: DominoStock – Multi-Store Inventory Sync & Stock Manager for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoStock is an advanced, high-performance WooCommerce inventory management and multi-store stock synchronization plugin built with a modern React interface.

Manage stock levels effortlessly, connect multiple WooCommerce stores via secure REST API & real-time webhooks, track inventory valuations, and automatically synchronize catalog stock statuses (instock, outofstock, onbackorder) across all your stores.

Whether you run a single WooCommerce store needing instant stock updates and low-stock alerts, or multiple satellite stores needing centralized stock management, DominoStock delivers seamless real-time stock synchronization without race conditions or circular loops.

Key Features for WooCommerce Stock Management

  • Multi-Store Inventory Sync: Synchronize stock levels across unlimited WooCommerce stores in real-time (Hub-to-Child & Child-to-Hub).
  • Real-Time Automated Webhooks: Instantly deduct and restore inventory quantities whenever orders are placed, cancelled, or updated.
  • Visual Stock Sync Monitor: Live audit log displaying stock transitions (old quantity → new quantity), flow direction, and payload diagnostics.
  • Multi Store Manager: Connect unlimited WooCommerce stores via standard WooCommerce REST API Consumer Keys.
  • Variable Product & SKU Matching: Accurately sync specific variation stocks using SKU or product title without affecting unchanged variations.
  • Fast React Dashboard: Lightning-fast, modern React & Chakra UI interface for smooth product searching, filtering, and instant inline edits.
  • Bulk Stock Adjustment: Perform bulk stock updates and catalog status realignment with 1-click execution or dry-run simulation mode.
  • Inventory Valuation & Analytics: Interactive ApexCharts displaying total stock value, stock status distribution, and low stock watchlist.
  • Loop-Safe Architecture: Built-in originating store detection guarantees zero circular webhook loops between connected stores.
  • HPOS Compatible: 100% compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Why Store Owners Choose DominoStock

  1. Prevent Overselling Across Stores: When an item sells on Store A, DominoStock immediately updates stock on the Primary Hub and all connected Child stores.
  2. Fix Out-of-Sync Stock Statuses: Automatically recalculates and realigns WooCommerce catalog stock status when manual edits or bulk imports disrupt stock numbers.
  3. No Developer Needed: Connect child stores in seconds using standard WooCommerce REST API Consumer Keys.

Unlock automated real-time multi-store inventory synchronization via webhooks, unlimited connected stores, bidirectional sync, and dedicated priority support.

sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dominostock-inventory-sync/, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins directory (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to DominoStock in your WordPress admin menu to manage inventory or connect child stores.
sections.faq:
Does DominoStock support multi-store inventory sync?

Yes! DominoStock allows you to connect multiple WooCommerce child stores to your primary hub site using WooCommerce REST API and real-time webhooks.

Can I sync stock for variable products?

Yes. DominoStock intelligently resolves product variations by SKU or variation name, updating only the specific variation whose stock changed.

How does real-time stock synchronization work?

When an order is created or edited on any connected store, a secure webhook payload is dispatched to update inventory quantities across all stores instantly.

Is DominoStock compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, DominoStock is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables).

Does DominoStock work with bulk imports or manual stock updates?

Yes. You can run one-click stock status synchronization anytime to reconcile WooCommerce catalog status with actual inventory numbers.

What extra features are included in DominoStock Pro?

DominoStock Pro unlocks automated real-time multi-store inventory synchronization via webhooks on child store orders, bidirectional multi-store syncing, and dedicated priority support. Upgrade to DominoStock Pro.
